title: Shennong's chairman hands ex-wife $350m stake as pig prices slide
title_zh: 猪价跌不停，神农集团董事长离婚分给前妻24.8亿股权

image.credit: Photo by Ben Mater on Unsplash
image.author: Ben Mater

lead: He Zuxun, chairman of Yunnan pig producer Shennong Group, has transferred 14.88% of the company to his former wife in a divorce settlement. The split comes as the industry endures a second trough, and it narrows the room he has to arrange a succession.
lead_zh: 云南猪企神农集团董事长何祖训离婚，把公司14.88%的股份转给了前妻。眼下养猪业正二次探底，这笔分割也让他安排接班的空间变小了。

preview_zh: 神农集团公告称，何祖训与罗婉瑜已解除婚姻关系，何祖训所持股份的30%、即7830.5万股过户给前妻，按公告日收盘价31.7元计算，市值约24.82亿元。双方签署了一致行动协议，表决权保持统一，上市公司控制权不变，何祖训直接持股降至34.72%。
paragraphs: Shennong Group disclosed that He Zuxun and Luo Wanyu have dissolved their marriage, with 78.305 million shares — 30% of his holding, worth roughly 2.482 billion yuan at the announcement-day close of 31.7 yuan — passed to his ex-wife. The pair signed a concerted-action agreement, so voting power stays unified and control of the listed company is unchanged. He's direct stake falls to 34.72%.

The timing is unforgiving. Hog prices have slipped below 9 yuan per kilogram and the hog-to-grain ratio sits near 3.85:1, far under the 6:1 break-even line, so most producers lose money on every animal sold. Shennong's revenue rose 5% to 4.12 billion yuan in the first three quarters, but it booked a net loss and kept bleeding operating cash.

Shennong is retrenching: it scrapped a 290 million yuan private placement, paused the Guangxi Longmen farm until July 2026, and poured capital into existing Yunnan subsidiaries in Wenshan, Eryuan and Huaping. Dividends, historically tied to cycle profits, remain suspended. At the end of the third quarter its debt ratio was just 46%, with about 2 billion yuan in reserve.

The settlement also reshuffles the family's succession calculus. He's son He Xinyang — not Luo's child — has been groomed since 2019, rising from assistant to the president to vice general manager overseeing procurement, operations, HR and animal-nutrition research, yet he sits on neither the board nor the shareholder register. With nearly 15% now in Luo's hands, the equity He can deploy for a handover has shrunk.

At 61, He has yet to hand over the core breeding business, a judgement shaped by the cycle's brutality. Rivals show similar caution: at Muyuan, the founder's son Qin Muyuan runs slaughtering while professionals lead hog farming; Wensheng relies on a partnership model with several family members sharing governance. A genuine handover requires management and equity to close the loop — He Xinyang has neither.
paragraphs_zh: 神农集团公告称，何祖训与罗婉瑜已解除婚姻关系，何祖训所持股份的30%、即7830.5万股过户给前妻，按公告日收盘价31.7元计算，市值约24.82亿元。双方签署了一致行动协议，表决权保持统一，上市公司控制权不变，何祖训直接持股降至34.72%。
时机相当不利。猪价已跌破9元/公斤，猪粮比约3.85:1，远低于6:1的盈亏线，多数猪企卖一头亏一头。神农集团前三季度营收增长5%至41.2亿元，但归母净利润亏损，经营现金流持续净流出。
神农集团正在收缩：终止2.9亿元定增，广西龙门猪场项目暂停至2026年7月，并把资金投向文山、洱源、华坪等云南本土子公司。分红历来随猪周期利润起伏，目前继续搁置。三季度末资产负债率仅46%，资金储备约20亿元。
这场分割也改变了家族传承的盘算。何祖训之子何昕阳并非罗婉瑜所生，自2019年进入公司，从总裁助理升至副总经理，分管采购、运营、人力和动物营养研发，但既未进入董事会，也不直接或间接持股。如今近15%股权落到罗婉瑜手中，何祖训可用于交接的股权筹码明显缩水。
何祖训已61岁，却仍未交出养殖主业，这与猪周期的残酷不无关系。同行同样谨慎：牧原股份创始人之子秦牧原负责屠宰，养猪主业由职业团队主导；温氏则靠合伙制，由多名家族成员共同治理。真正接班需要管理权与股权形成闭环，而何昕阳两者皆无。
